anomaliesExplained.obj13_why_383mb_and_7_processes: The previous Gate 14.1 benchmark script used a Named Pipe helper that sent {"action":"open_progress","job_id":"task-sample-1"} and {"action":"hide_window"}. However, crates/tdm-native-host/src/lib.rs handle_message did not implement "open_progress" or "hide_window", returning "Unknown action". Furthermore, "task-sample-1" did not exist in SQLite, causing open_progress_window_internal to abort early. Consequently, no toast window was ever created, no window was ever hidden or minimized, and the process tree remained completely static throughout the entire benchmark script at 7 processes and ~383 MB working set.
